P2P baby monitor web app: WebRTC (PeerJS), Vite + TypeScript; Baby Station streams camera/mic, Parent Station receives stream.

Files: `src/main.ts` routing/URL state; `src/baby-station.ts` camera/mic, QR, settings; `src/parent-station.ts` video, audio/motion meters, alerts, reconnection; `src/motion-detection.ts` frame differencing; `src/utils.ts` wake lock/media/audio helpers; `src/style.css` global dark theme; `src/dictionary.ts` room IDs; colocated `src/*.test.ts` (Vitest globals). Playwright e2e: `tests/` (excluded from Vitest). Dev certs: `scripts/`; `certs/` (self-signed, gitignored keys); assets: `public/`. Build/deploy: `vite.config.ts`, `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.

**Rules**
- Each station is self-contained with `init*` returning a `CleanupHandle`.
- All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for proper teardown
- Use `querySelectorOrThrow()` - never silently fail on missing DOM
- URL state uses `station`, `roomId` params.
- Always request on station init, release in cleanup
- Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup
- Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`)
- Don't hardcode PeerJS peer IDs in parent station (random ID, call by room)
- Room IDs: `WordWordWord1234` format (`src/dictionary.ts`).
- UI: full-screen video, slide-up `.settings-drawer`; CSS custom properties in `:root`, dark theme default; `.toast` alerts and `.video-alert` video glow.
- Parent retries wait 5s+; baby station prefers `facingMode: environment` on mobile; audio meter uses `level * 3`; motion detection uses 160x120 downsampled video, 2-second alert cooldown.
- No separate vitest.config; config is in `vite.config.ts`. Vitest runs `src/*.test.ts`; Playwright tests in `tests/` are excluded via `vite.config.ts`.
- Bun package
